run_f_gold: run f_gold to add 1 to a given number using bitwise XOR and left shift operations
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple integer inputs to verify it correctly adds 1 to each number
review_f_gold: review f_gold which implements adding 1 to a number using bitwise operations instead of arithmetic
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that adds 1 to an integer by flipping trailing 1-bits and setting the lowest 0-bit
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to add 1 to a number using standard arithmetic instead of bitwise operations
